scientific.integrity: The main argument is analytic. The bundled verifier checks explicit zero, skew, indefinite, coercive, and vanishing-eigenvalue operator examples. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the operator hypothesis required for the displayed quotient feedback to be well defined and uniformly bounded. It does not re-prove every downstream nonlinear stabilization step under the repaired coercivity condition.

title: The bounded-operator hypothesis does not define the published predator–prey feedback
